units.assessment: Can you say how many cycles of high-dose carboplatin and etoposide make up standard salvage for relapsed germ cell tumour, and which relapsed patients should go straight to high-dose therapy rather than conventional salvage?

lesson.note: Re-searched on the regimens and eponyms rather than the section title — high-dose carboplatin and etoposide, the TI-CE regimen, Indiana high-dose salvage, autologous rescue for relapsed germ cell tumour. The second pass returned a Dana-Farber patient explainer on testicular cancer treatment, a 2014 patient symposium and an ovarian cancer animation. Salvage high-dose chemotherapy with autologous rescue in germ cell tumours is simply not taught on YouTube at the level a fellow needs; read the chapter and the TI-CE and TIGER reports instead.

units.name: Pediatric solid tumors
units.assessment: Can you explain why consolidation for high-risk neuroblastoma uses one or two sequential autologous transplants, and say what the graft contributes given that these are chemosensitive solid tumours?

lesson.note: Re-searched on tandem autologous transplant, the Children's Oncology Group ANBL0532 trial and high-risk neuroblastoma consolidation. The only on-topic result is a short journal summary of the tandem-versus-single transplant trial, attached below as supplementary. Everything else returned was haploidentical transplant, CAR-T or fundraising appeals, so no lecture here covers autologous consolidation for paediatric solid tumours as a whole.
